nodes.title: Membership in a diagonal test relation

nodes.summary: A one-step simulation lifts to arbitrary finite iteration. The simulator `p` need not be invertible or a test.
nodes.title: A one-step simulation lifts to finite iteration

nodes.summary: A postcondition can be absorbed on the right exactly when it holds on every execution starting in the precondition.
nodes.title: Postcondition absorption characterizes partial correctness

nodes.summary: The verification inequality is precisely universal partial correctness: every execution from `P` ends in `Q`.
nodes.title: Verification inequality characterizes partial correctness

nodes.summary: Classically, verification means that no execution from `P` can reach the complement of `Q`.
nodes.title: Partial correctness as unreachability of the negated postcondition

nodes.summary: Boolean test negation is complement relative to identity, not the full relation-algebra complement (which includes off-diagonal pairs).
nodes.title: Test of a negated assertion is the complement within identity

nodes.summary: The false assertion is the zero relation.
nodes.title: Test of the false assertion is the zero relation

nodes.summary: A test is a subidentity, not an arbitrary relation.
nodes.title: Diagonal tests are subidentities

nodes.summary: Sequential tests conjoin their assertions without changing state.
nodes.title: Composing diagonal tests conjoins their assertions

nodes.summary: Union of assertions is union of their diagonal tests.
nodes.title: Test of a union of assertions is the union of tests

nodes.summary: The true assertion is the identity relation.
nodes.title: Test of the true assertion is the identity relation

nodes.summary: The diagonal relation restricted to an assertion.
nodes.title: Diagonal test relation of an assertion

nodes.summary: An idempotent subidentity preserved by one step is preserved by iteration. This is a corollary of `star_simulation`; the test assumptions are explicit, with no additional algebraic structure.
nodes.title: Tests preserved by one step are preserved by iteration

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
